content: कष् I. €1 <ab>U.</ab> (कषति-ते, कषित) .²1 To rub, scratch, scrape; समूलकाषं कषति <ls>Sk.</ls>; <ls>Bk. 3. 49</ls>. .²2 To test, try, rub on a touch-stone (as gold); छदहेम कषन्निवालसत्कषपाषाणनिभे नभस्तले <ls>N. 2. 69</ls>. .²3 To injure, destroy. .²4 To itch. .²5 To leap. --II. €10 <ab>P.</ab> (काषयति) To hurt.
